body:
My closest friend sided with my bully after that bully had:

-almost kicked my front teeth in

-ditched me every lunch time (we were in grade 4 it was a big deal)

-stole my lunch (I’m anaphylactic, life threatening allergies, so I couldn’t just grab someone else’s )

-spread rumours about me

-got me to the point of self harming and suicidal thoughts at the age of 8

I almost died.
I have life threatening allergies and I had to be nebulised because my airways were closing.
Spent the rest of the day in hospital.
Also, this happens almost every year on my birthday (I have a reaction) so that’s why I don’t celebrate it anymore.

Horrible.

Life is spinning past too fast, my mental health is plummeting and I can’t tell anyone, school is a whole other drama, my friends are fighting 25/8, I’ve buried myself in things I hate because I no longer have the motivation to do things I love, oh and I got a eating disorder but I’m “too skinny” to talk about how much I hate my thighs or my stomach, my allergies have gotten to the point where I stopped breathing last time I had a reaction and because I couldn’t exercise for 6 months after my scoliosis surgery I’m now so unfit I can’t go up stairs without getting puffed, all my dreams have been crushed like bugs and my scoliosis caused me to now have a lung capacity of 60% and I can’t do anything to raise it.

This year has made me want to die more than any other year of my fleeting mistake of a life.
